$comment: Campaign enemies (round 05, stream D). Tower/HQ stats live in tanks.json (pve:true). threatCost = budget points an outpost spends per unit (levels.json → outposts[].budget). guard: enemy tanks patrol within radius tiles of their outpost and only react to enemies within leash tiles of it, so outposts are fought one at a time. hqClearance: free tiles needed around the HQ. minSpacing: tiles between placed units. All numbers are a first proposal — owner decides (rule 4).
